summary: Frontend-only testing of role-conditional mandatory Customer Name / Contact Number on MIS page (Apr-2026). Admin: no '*' on Customer Name & Contact Number in BOTH Add and Edit forms (PASS). Manager & Agent: '*' shown in both Add and Edit forms, and submitting empty shows toast 'Customer Name is required' then 'Contact Number is required' (ALL PASS). FAILED: Admin cannot actually create a loan with empty Customer Name/Contact Number — POST /api/loans returns 422 ('customer_name Field required') and UI shows 'Failed to add loan', dialog stays open.

critical.issue: LoanApplicationCreate (server.py line 215) declares customer_name: str (required) -> 422 'Field required' when frontend omits it. Admin therefore cannot submit the form with Customer Name empty, defeating the new optional-for-admin requirement. Verified via curl: payload without customer_name => 422; same payload with customer_name:"" => 200. Fix: make customer_name Optional[str] = "" in LoanApplicationCreate (and keep contact_no optional), OR in MonthlyMIS.handleAddLoan default submitData.customer_name/contact_no to '' before POST.

ui_bugs.issue: Contact Number input and Agent Name/Status/Bank controls have no data-testid (had to use label-based XPath). Add data-testid="add-contact-input"/"edit-contact-input", add-agent/status/bank selects.

integration_issues.flow: Admin Add Entry with empty Customer Name/Contact Number
integration_issues.issue: Submission fails with backend 422; toast shows generic 'Failed to add loan' instead of creating the loan. Toast also does not surface the real backend validation detail.

action_items: Make customer_name optional in backend LoanApplicationCreate (Optional[str] = "") so admin can submit empty Customer Name; alternatively send '' from handleAddLoan.
Surface backend error detail in the 'Failed to add loan' toast (error.response?.data?.detail) for easier debugging.
Add data-testid to Contact Number input and Agent/Status/Bank selects in Add & Edit forms.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend-only role validation (handleAddLoan/handleEditSave) is not mirrored in backend: a non-admin could POST without customer_name-only guard bypass via API; and admin path is blocked by strict Pydantic model. Align role-based requiredness on the server (e.g. validate based on current_user.role).
MonthlyMIS.jsx is ~2000 lines — should be split into smaller components (AddEntryDialog, EditEntryDialog, MonthGroupTable).
seed_data_creation: Created one loan via API (customer_name='', Apr-2026, agent TEST_AGENT_QA) to verify backend accepts empty strings; it was deleted afterwards (DELETE 200). No UI-created test loans remained (submission 422'd). Apr-2026 still has 8 pre-existing rows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Month groups collapsed by default; use [data-testid="add-entry-Apr-2026"] to open Add form and [data-testid="month-header-Apr-2026"] to expand rows, then [data-testid^="mis-edit-"] for edit. Labels are read via 'div[role=dialog] form label'. Asterisk logic works for all 3 roles in Add+Edit; only the admin empty-submission end-to-end save needs retest after backend model fix.
rca_of_the_issue: handleAddLoan spreads newLoanData, which never contains customer_name/contact_no keys if untouched, so the POST body omits them. Pydantic LoanApplicationCreate.customer_name is a required str -> 422. Sending empty strings succeeds, so either default the fields in the frontend payload or make the model field optional.
